focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞：廠務工程、封裝測試及投資政策
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia: facilities, packaging and test, and investment policy

throughline.zh: 聯電公告新加坡廠務採購，景碩和矽品更新台灣載板與封測廠房進度，越南則列出 2030 年前的半導體引資項目。
throughline.en: UMC disclosed facilities purchases in Singapore, Kinsus and SPIL updated Taiwan substrate and packaging projects, and Vietnam listed semiconductor investment priorities through 2030.

text.zh: 聯電公告新加坡 P4 廠務設備與工程三筆交易，原值合計約 367.64 億元，用於第 4 期無塵室。
text.en: UMC disclosed three Singapore P4 facilities and construction transactions totaling about NT$36.76 billion for phase-four cleanroom work.

text.zh: 中央社引述經濟部，景碩高階 ABF 載板擴產案獲通過，規劃投資 601.7 億元，未公布新增產能。
text.en: CNA quoted MOEA as saying Kinsus received clearance for a NT$60.17 billion advanced ABF substrate plan. Additional capacity was not specified.

text.zh: 矽品董事會通過以 197 億元未稅取得友達桃園華亞廠，尚未公告廠區設備配置與投產時間。
text.en: SPIL’s board approved the NT$19.7 billion acquisition of AUO’s Hwaya facility before tax. Tool configurations and production timing are pending.

text.zh: 台灣第三季實質 GDP 初步統計年增 14.39%，半導體設備進口額按新台幣計年增 36.04%。
text.en: Taiwan’s preliminary Q3 real GDP rose 14.39% year over year. Semiconductor equipment import values in New Taiwan dollars rose 36.04%.

text.zh: 越南核定 2030 年前半導體及電子國際合作計畫，將晶片設計、先進封測與研發用資料中心列為引資重點。
text.en: Vietnam approved a semiconductor and electronics cooperation plan through 2030 targeting foreign investment in chip design, advanced packaging and testing, and research data centers.

title.zh: 聯電公告新加坡 P4 廠務及工程交易，三筆合計約 367.64 億元
title.en: UMC discloses NT$36.76 billion in three Singapore P4 engineering and facilities transactions

summary.zh: 聯電 11 月 27 日公告新加坡 P4 廠區相關工程與廠務設備共三筆交易，按公司公告金額合計約新台幣 367.64 億元。聯電對中央社表示，工程主要用於建置第 4 期廠區無塵室，以擴充矽光子產能。
summary.en: UMC disclosed three engineering and facilities transactions for its Singapore P4 site on November 27. The exact disclosures total about NT$36.76 billion. UMC told CNA that the work primarily builds phase-four cleanroom space to expand silicon photonics capacity.

text.zh: 聯電董事會已於 7 月 29 日通過擴建新加坡 P4 無塵室。聯電同日表示，7 月已交付首批 12 吋矽光子量產晶圓，並規劃 2027 年推出供更多客戶導入的平台。
text.en: UMC’s board approved expansion of Singapore P4 cleanroom capacity on July 29. UMC said that day that it had delivered its first volume-production 12-inch silicon photonics wafers in July and planned to open the platform to more customers in 2027.

text.zh: 按公告原值，聯電向 L&K Engineering 取得廠務設備約 183.76 億元，向 LIMK Engineering 取得另一批設備約 170.16 億元，另與 L&K 簽約委建廠房約 13.72 億元。中央社報導合計約 367.62 億元，按三筆公告原值加總為 367.64 億元。
text.en: The disclosures list about NT$18.38 billion in facilities equipment from L&K Engineering, NT$17.02 billion from LIMK Engineering and NT$1.37 billion in construction with L&K. CNA reported NT$36.762 billion, compared with NT$36.764 billion when the three disclosed amounts are summed before rounding.

title.zh: 投資台灣事務所通過景碩擴充高階 ABF 載板案，規劃投資 601.7 億元
title.en: InvesTaiwan clears Kinsus plan to invest NT$60.17 billion in advanced ABF substrates

summary.zh: 中央社 11 月 27 日引述經濟部新聞稿報導，投資台灣事務所通過景碩科技約新台幣 601.7 億元的高階 ABF 載板擴產案。計畫擴建北部廠區、添購設備，預估新增 1,074 個本國職缺。
summary.en: CNA reported on November 27, citing Taiwan’s economic ministry, that InvesTaiwan cleared Kinsus Technology’s roughly NT$60.17 billion advanced ABF substrate plan. It includes expansion and equipment at a northern Taiwan site and an estimated 1,074 domestic jobs.

text.zh: ABF 載板用於高階晶片封裝。中央社引述經濟部稱，景碩規劃在新產線導入數位製程監控與品質管理，並搭配節能措施。
text.en: ABF substrates are used in advanced chip packaging. CNA cited the ministry as saying Kinsus plans digital process monitoring and quality management on the new lines, along with energy efficiency measures.

text.zh: 同批三案總額約 611 億元。另外，品睿精密規劃約 6.9 億元擴充彰化花壇三座工廠，涵蓋先進封測設備零件、高階治具及純銅積層製造。
text.en: The three approvals in the batch total about NT$61.1 billion. Pin Rui Precision separately plans about NT$690 million to expand three plants in Huatan, Changhua, for uses including packaging and test equipment parts, fixtures and additive manufacturing in pure copper.

title.zh: 矽品董事會通過以 197 億元取得友達桃園華亞廠
title.en: SPIL board approves NT$19.7 billion acquisition of AUO’s Hwaya facility

summary.zh: 日月光投控與友達 11 月 27 日公告，矽品董事會通過以未稅新台幣 197 億元，取得友達在桃園龜山的華亞廠土地、建物及附屬廠務設施。買方公告用途為營運所需，未列封裝或測試產線配置。
summary.en: ASE Technology Holding and AUO disclosed on November 27 that SPIL’s board approved acquiring AUO’s Hwaya land, buildings and facilities in Guishan, Taoyuan, for NT$19.7 billion before tax. The buyer cited operational use and did not specify packaging or test lines.

text.zh: 矽品是日月光投控旗下封裝測試公司。本案所涉土地面積為 65,260.09 平方公尺，建物面積為 162,826.12 平方公尺，另包含一批廠務附屬設備。
text.en: SPIL is an ASE Technology Holding packaging and testing subsidiary. The transaction covers 65,260.09 square meters of land, 162,826.12 square meters of buildings and related facility equipment.

text.zh: 友達預計處分利益約 104 億元，已扣除相關交易費用及預估稅費。自由時報報導，友達原擬出售給廣達，前案於 10 月底終止。
text.en: AUO expects a disposal gain of about NT$10.4 billion after transaction costs and estimated taxes. Liberty Times reported that AUO terminated the prior proposed sale to Quanta in late October.

title.zh: 台灣第三季實質 GDP 初步統計年增 14.39%，半導體設備進口額年增 36.04%
title.en: Taiwan preliminary Q3 real GDP rises 14.39%, with semiconductor equipment imports up 36.04%

summary.zh: 主計總處 11 月 27 日公布，台灣第三季實質 GDP 初步統計年增 14.39%，較 10 月概估高 0.03 個百分點。半導體設備進口額按新台幣計年增 36.04%，製造業實質毛額年增 21.39%。
summary.en: Taiwan’s statistics agency reported on November 27 that preliminary Q3 real GDP rose 14.39% year over year, 0.03 percentage points above its October advance estimate. Semiconductor equipment import values rose 36.04% in New Taiwan dollars and real manufacturing value added rose 21.39%.

text.zh: 第三季新台幣計價資本設備進口年增 58.72%，實質固定資本形成成長 20.12%，其中民間固定投資成長 24.44%。主計總處指出，企業為因應 AI 基礎設施擴充及應用升級，投資先進製程與產能。
text.en: Capital equipment imports measured in New Taiwan dollars rose 58.72%. Real fixed capital formation increased 20.12%, including 24.44% growth in private fixed investment. DGBAS cited spending on advanced processes and capacity tied to AI infrastructure and applications.

text.zh: 第三季實質 GDP 季調後季增 2.86%，折成年率為 11.94%。主計總處將 2026 全年經濟成長預測由 11.05% 上修至 13.28%，2027 年由 6.04% 上修至 6.51%。
text.en: Seasonally adjusted real GDP rose 2.86% quarter on quarter, or 11.94% annualized. DGBAS raised its annual growth forecast to 13.28% from 11.05% for 2026 and to 6.51% from 6.04% for 2027.

title.zh: 穎崴說明探針擴產，2027 年第二季底月產能目標 1,400 萬支
title.en: WinWay targets monthly capacity of 14 million probes by the end of Q2 2027

summary.zh: 穎崴 11 月 26 日在台北凱基證券投資論壇說明自製探針擴產，中央社及自由時報引述公司稱，2026 年底月產能約 900 萬支，2027 年第二季底目標 1,400 萬支。公司把先進晶片封裝尺寸增加與測試時間延長列為需求背景。
summary.en: WinWay outlined plans to expand in-house probe capacity at KGI’s Taipei investor conference on November 26. CNA and Liberty Times cited a year-end 2026 run rate of about nine million probes per month and a target of 14 million by the end of Q2 2027. The company cited larger chip packages and longer test times.

text.zh: 探針與高階測試座用於連接被測晶片與測試設備。中央社引述公司稱，2026 年自製探針預計產出 7,700 萬支，2025 年生產 3,300 萬支。以 5,000 接腳規格計算的高階測試座，2026 年預估 3.82 萬顆，2025 年產出 2.1 萬顆。
text.en: Probes and advanced sockets connect devices to semiconductor test equipment. CNA cited expected 2026 probe output of 77 million against 33 million in 2025, and 38,200 advanced sockets on a 5,000-pin basis against 21,000 in 2025.

text.zh: 中央社與自由時報引述的 2027 年底月產能目標為 2,400 萬支，鉅亨網報導的 2027 年下半年規劃則為 2,900 萬支。兩個數字的月份及設備配置未能核對為同一口徑。
text.en: CNA and Liberty Times cited a year-end 2027 target of 24 million a month. Anue reported 29 million for the second half of 2027. The time windows and equipment assumptions could not be reconciled.

title.zh: 越南核定 2030 年前半導體及電子國際合作計畫
title.en: Vietnam approves international cooperation plan for semiconductors and electronics through 2030

summary.zh: 越南總理 11 月 26 日核定第 2320 號決定，政府於 27 日公布計畫的七項措施。外資重點包括晶片設計、先進封裝測試，以及供產業研發與訓練使用的資料中心和超級電腦。
summary.en: Vietnam’s prime minister signed Decision 2320 on November 26, and the government outlined seven measures the following day. Foreign investment priorities include chip design, advanced packaging and testing, and data centers and supercomputers for research and training.

text.zh: 措施涵蓋合作協定、引進外資與專家、人才訓練、技術移轉、共用研發設施、供應鏈建設及協助本地企業拓展國際市場。
text.en: The measures cover cooperation agreements, foreign capital and expertise, training, technology transfer, shared research infrastructure, supply-chain development and market access for local firms.

text.zh: 政府電子報表示，官方發展援助及優惠貸款將尋求投入技術協助與產業能力建置。政策期間延續至 2030 年。
text.en: The government publication said Vietnam would seek official development assistance and concessional loans for technical assistance and industry capacity building. The program runs through 2030.

title.zh: 台勝科稱 8 吋與 12 吋矽晶圓產能滿載，8 吋啟動配額
title.en: Formosa Sumco says its 8-inch and 12-inch wafer lines are full, with allocation for 8-inch supply

summary.zh: MoneyDJ 與經濟日報 11 月 27 日引述台勝科於前一日台北法說會的說法，8 吋與 12 吋矽晶圓產能均已滿載，8 吋產線因現有供應不足以滿足客戶需求而啟動配額。公司點名 AI 伺服器電源管理晶片帶動 8 吋需求。
summary.en: MoneyDJ and Economic Daily News reported on November 27 that Formosa Sumco told its Taipei investor briefing the previous day that its 8-inch and 12-inch silicon wafer capacity was fully used. It began allocating 8-inch wafers, citing demand from AI server power management chips.

text.zh: 公司把先進製程與記憶體客戶拉貨列為 12 吋需求來源。MoneyDJ 引述公司指出，矽中介片和矽電容也帶來特殊規格晶圓需求。
text.en: The company cited leading-edge foundries and memory customers for 12-inch demand. MoneyDJ also quoted it on demand for specialty wafers used in silicon interposers and capacitors.

text.zh: 公司在法說表示，已與主要客戶合作開發特殊規格，相關產品陸續進入量產。媒體未列各規格的出貨量或配額分配方式。
text.en: The company said it had developed specialty specifications with major customers and some products were entering volume production. The reports did not break out shipments or allocation terms.

title.zh: 印尼與 OECD 發表半導體報告，盤點巴淡及西爪哇既有封測布局
title.en: Indonesia and OECD release semiconductor review identifying existing back-end operations

summary.zh: 印尼經濟事務統籌部與 OECD 11 月 25 日在雅加達發表半導體產業報告。報告指出，當地能力目前集中在組裝、測試與封裝，既有外資布局包括巴淡島和西爪哇。
summary.en: Indonesia’s Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs and the OECD presented a semiconductor industry review in Jakarta on November 25. It describes local capabilities as concentrated in assembly, testing and packaging, with longstanding foreign investment in Batam and West Java.

text.zh: 報告在封測章節列出英飛凌、UTAC 與夏普等既有投資，並將公用設施、物流及技術人才列為產業條件。巴淡島長期承接電子製造及後段封裝業務。
text.en: The report names existing investments by Infineon, UTAC and Sharp and discusses utilities, logistics and skilled labor. Batam has longstanding electronics manufacturing and back-end operations.

text.zh: 經濟事務統籌部表示將把報告建議納入改革討論，並提到半導體產業所需的可靠供電。巴淡、西爪哇及企業案例是這次報告整理的既有布局。
text.en: The coordinating ministry said it would bring the recommendations into reform discussions and cited reliable power for semiconductor operations. The cases in Batam and West Java describe existing operations reviewed for the report.

title.zh: CPTPP 在河內通過設立印尼及菲律賓入會工作小組
title.en: CPTPP members agree to establish accession working groups for Indonesia and the Philippines

summary.zh: 越南政府公布，CPTPP 成員 11 月 27 日在河內舉行第 11 次部長級委員會會議，通過設立印尼、菲律賓及阿拉伯聯合大公國入會工作小組。成員另同意推動協定升級談判，議題包括海關及貿易便捷化。
summary.en: Vietnam reported that CPTPP members agreed at their 11th ministerial commission meeting in Hanoi on November 27 to set up accession working groups for Indonesia, the Philippines and the United Arab Emirates. Members also agreed to advance negotiations on topics including customs and trade facilitation.

text.zh: 入會工作小組負責審查申請方的制度與承諾。越南副工貿部長向媒體說明，協定升級的討論也涵蓋電子商務、跨境服務和企業競爭力。
text.en: Accession working groups examine applicant rules and commitments. Vietnam’s deputy trade minister also identified e-commerce, cross-border services and business competitiveness as topics for the agreement upgrade.

text.zh: 目前進度為成立工作小組，後續仍要談判及完成成員程序。會議未公布印尼或菲律賓的產品別減稅表與原產地條件。
text.en: The decision establishes working groups. Negotiations and member procedures still lie ahead, with no product tariff schedules or origin terms for Indonesia or the Philippines announced.

question.zh: 聯電 367.64 億元涵蓋哪些交易？
question.en: What does UMC’s NT$36.76 billion total include?

text.zh: 合計來自兩批廠務設備及一筆租地委建契約。各筆按聯電公告原值加總，尚無單一機台或新產能明細。
text.en: The total adds two facilities equipment transactions and a construction contract on leased land using the exact disclosure amounts. The filings do not give a tool-by-tool or new capacity breakdown.

question.zh: 矽品交易金額與友達預計處分利益如何區分？
question.en: How do SPIL’s transaction price and AUO’s expected gain differ?

text.zh: 197 億元是未稅資產交易金額。104 億元是友達扣除交易費用及預估稅費後估計的處分利益。
text.en: NT$19.7 billion is the before-tax price for the assets. NT$10.4 billion is AUO’s estimated gain after transaction fees and estimated taxes.

question.zh: 自製探針的月產能與預估全年產量如何比較？
question.en: How do the monthly probe capacity target and projected annual output differ?

text.zh: 1,400 萬支是 2027 年第二季底的月產能目標。7,700 萬支則是公司對 2026 年全年產出的估計，涵蓋不同期間及口徑。
text.en: Fourteen million probes is the monthly capacity target at the end of Q2 2027. Seventy-seven million is projected output for all of 2026, a distinct measure and time period.

verificationNote.zh: 聯電三筆交易依公告原值加總，與媒體約數略有差異。景碩投資審查結果引述自經濟部提供媒體的資訊，未列新產能。穎崴下半年與年底產能數字在報導間未能核對為同一口徑。
verificationNote.en: UMC’s total uses exact disclosed amounts and differs slightly from the rounded figure in coverage. The reported ministry information on Kinsus gives no capacity increment. WinWay’s second-half and year-end probe figures could not be reconciled across reports.
